name: oceanhud

scripts.test:syntax: node --check OceanHub_SECURITY_PATCHED_FINAL_v18.js && node --check repo-audit-helpers.mjs && node --check security_checks_v18.mjs && node --check email_verification_flow_test.mjs && node --check key_at_rest_test_v18.mjs && node --check key_index_route_test_v18.mjs && node --check backup_migration_tool_test_v18.mjs && node --check ui_theme_test_v18.mjs && node --check paypal_mode_test_v18.mjs
